title: Morning rush in Rome: every bus, tram and metro train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Rome, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus, tram and metro train inside the city on an average October weekday. The feed has no FL regional trains, no Roma-Lido, Roma-Viterbo or Termini-Giardinetti trains and no Cotral buses, so they are not shown.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Rome city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Metro, Tram and ATAC bus, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 1,763 vehicles at 8:30 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable. Roma Servizi per la Mobilità starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out.
